resources.string: Prepare a text message, then send it from your SMS app. FloodCue does not send SMS by itself.
Enter one number at a time, or several numbers separated by commas. Only numbers you add here will be used.
That entry is not a valid phone number: %1$s
That number is already in the list.
EMERGENCY! I need help. Please contact me as soon as possible.
Location is optional. GPS can work without internet. FloodCue will not include coordinates unless you get or choose a valid location.

Last known location (not a live GPS reading)
Latitude: %1$s
Longitude: %2$s
Recorded: %3$s
A last known location is available from this device. It is not your current location unless you choose to use it.
Location permission is needed to read GPS. You can still send the SOS without coordinates.
Location permission was denied. You can continue without coordinates, or enable location permission in system settings.
GPS is turned off. Turn on location services to get coordinates, or continue without them.
Could not get a current location. Check that GPS is on and try again, or continue without coordinates.
Could not get a fresh GPS reading in time. You can try again, use a last known location if one is shown, or continue without coordinates.
FloodCue cannot confirm delivery. You must tap Send in your SMS app.
Add at least one valid number and a message before sending.

These numbers will be passed to your SMS app:

%1$s

FloodCue will not send the SMS itself. Check the recipients and message, then tap Send in the SMS app.

Some SMS apps only fill the first recipient. If that happens, add the remaining numbers yourself before sending. FloodCue will not drop numbers from this list.
SMS app opened. Delivery is not confirmed until you send the message and the recipient receives it.
No compatible SMS app was found. Your numbers and message are still saved on this screen.
Could not open the SMS app. Your numbers and message are still saved on this screen.
You can prepare this SOS without internet. Sending an SMS still needs a working cellular SMS service.
